comments.body: Closing in favor of #1113, which moves every model in `examples/` to the newest in its series. That PR updates this same line in `img_url_example.py` to `bedrock/global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`. It keeps the `global.` inference profile used here, because Sonnet 5.5 on Bedrock can only be called through an inference profile. Thanks for flagging the retired model.
